title: Xbox 25th anniversary memo: a fifth console generation is on the way

sources.note: Xbox Wire memo to Team XBOX, signed Asha: four console generations with a fifth on the way; more than a billion players a year; 111 staff with 25+ years get an engraved console; no name, date or specs; no video on the post

footage: stills: Xbox Wire's four official anniversary images (no video on the post, no official video reachable); business story
gate: gate 15:55Z: digest VERDICT CONFIRMED with FACTS; primary read for the wording; no denial expected for an official post

angle.hook: Xbox tells its own staff that a fifth console generation is on the way
angle.why_now: the memo went to Team XBOX employees on the 25th anniversary, 12 Nov 2026, and is public on Xbox Wire
angle.what_it_means_here: Xbox gives no name, date or specs for the next console, so Gulf players learn only that a new generation is confirmed
angle.payoff: a fifth generation is on the way, with no name, date or specs yet
